<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TravelBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BookingRequest" name="Booking request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Reminder and check-in instructions"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_TravelBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BookingRequest" name="Booking request" sourceRef="Send_BookingRequest" targetRef="Start_BookingReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="Send_Ticket" targetRef="Receive_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Reminder and check-in instructions" sourceRef="Send_Reminder" targetRef="Receive_Reminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Travel" name="Travel needed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Search_Ticket" name="Search for ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Select_Route" name="Select route, date and time"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Provide_Details" name="Provide personal and payment details"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_BookingRequest" name="Send booking request" messageRef="Msg_BookingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Ticket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Reminder" name="Receive reminders and check-in instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Complete_Journey" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Provide_Feedback" name="Provide post-travel feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Concluded" name="Journey concluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Travel" targetRef="Search_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Search_Ticket" targetRef="Select_Route"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Select_Route" targetRef="Provide_Details"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Provide_Details" targetRef="Send_BookingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Send_BookingRequest" targetRef="Receive_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Receive_Ticket" targetRef="Receive_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Receive_Reminder" targetRef="Complete_Journey"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Complete_Journey" targetRef="Provide_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Provide_Feedback" targetRef="End_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Travel Company Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BookingReceived" name="Booking request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BookingRequest" messageRef="Msg_BookingRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Generate_Ticket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Ticket" name="Send ticket by email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Update_Inventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Reminder" name="Send reminders and check-in instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Booking" name="Booking closed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T1" sourceRef="Start_BookingReceived" targetRef="Generate_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T2" sourceRef="Generate_Ticket" targetRef="Send_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T3" sourceRef="Send_Ticket" targetRef="Update_Inventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T4" sourceRef="Update_Inventory" targetRef="Send_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T5" sourceRef="Send_Reminder" targetRef="End_Booking"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
